brand.name: Your product
brand.detectedFrom: your product site CSS + local styles.css (adjust by hand)

authorName: <your name as printed on the paper>

github.label: Release notes repo (off by default)
github.note: Uncomment by setting enabled:true once the repo is public, or configure a token elsewhere if it is private — this tool does not store credentials.

jsonapi.label: bioRxiv / medRxiv preprint by DOI
jsonapi.author: <your name as printed on the paper>
jsonapi.note: The DOI path is the main entry point (post_facts { doi }). Fill author to get author matching; empty author means the 'author' facts are skipped with a 待补 note.

arxiv.label: arXiv (off by default)
arxiv.note: Kept for compatibility; prefer the generic json-api / rss adapter instead of code changes.

site.label: Product version (online endpoint + local version file)
site.note: This is the generic 'did we actually ship it' guard: the online endpoint and the local version file must agree, otherwise copy / mark-posted are refused (409). Point url and local.file at your own product and set enabled:true. Feature bullets only come from releaseNotesFiles; if the version is missing there it falls back to referenceFile quotes, and with neither it stays 待补.
